owned_conclusion.statement: For the bounded CPython-3.6 Linux context, the proposal removes the old prebuilt-wheel path and leaves a source-distribution fallback path.

stopping_evaluation.reason: Exact old/new package artifact inventories and new-release source/build metadata already discriminate the owned artifact-transition question.
stopping_evaluation.deeper_possible_question: Whether source fallback succeeds in one exact target-relevant Python-3.6 Linux environment.
stopping_evaluation.principle: Do not escalate to a materially more expensive observation when it cannot change the already-settled owned proposition and instead answers a different proposition.
